callSite: After actual Request construction and the existing guestCompletionBegin/guestCorrelationRequest snapshot; before unchanged V2 adapter-enter record.
callAdmission: Existing completionTrace must be defined. Existing route/trace logger fault/stopped/truncation state can prevent a call; absence is unavailable, not a native or completion observation.
ordinaryObservationFailure: Catch only the new ordinary synchronous observation error and call existing guestCompletionFault(); never modify app request/result/primary error/body/reader/disposal path. Uncatchable traps are outside this guarantee.
nativePromise: R-selected proposed native callback validates without coercion, stores POD only, and retains no JS argument edges. It is inactive at INIT and returns undefined. Actual API/build proof is absent.
nativeWindow: One existing native call window; all observe attempts saturate at2 and repeated/multiple observations are ambiguous even if equal. Native window and marker details require genuine separately reviewed native Source.

nativeRecordSchema.observations: active observe attempts saturated at1/2; any second attempt clears saved value and is ambiguous
nativeRecordSchema.methodAndPath: Only fixed enum-decoded GET/POST and /actions or /action-result, or -; never arbitrary argument text.
nativeRecordSchema.reason: Fixed native-selected vocabulary; exact sealed native contract remains required.
nativeRecordSchema.corr: exact64lowerhex only for single-valid, otherwise null
nativeRecordSchema.emission: At least one active observe attempt, only at native fulfilled+lowering success-return site. No record for zero attempts.
nativeRecordSchema.limits: 256 ordinary records and one short native-diagnostic-truncated record, then stop; no IDs or call counter.

builtinObject: Proposed exact own observe function: arity5, enumerable/read-only/permanent; no default. R uses content-realm JSAutoRealm and rooted record/value through genuine Engine.define_builtin_module.
